name: Baby City
description: Montevideo baby and childcare store selling strollers, car seats, feeding items, bath products, nursery furniture, clothing and toys online, with a showroom in Punta Carretas. Delivers to Montevideo and the interior.
description_es: Tienda de bebés y primera infancia de Montevideo con cochecitos, butacas, alimentación, baño, mobiliario, ropa y juguetes en línea, y local en Punta Carretas. Envía a Montevideo y al interior.

ships_to.notes: Montevideo estimated 2 to 4 business days; interior up to 5 business days depending on locality, per the store's shipping page

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Branch pickup is coordinated beforehand by WhatsApp, per the shipping page
